## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-02-22: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.13 to S-1
- 2021-03-17: Vine Energy Up-C IPO closes; executed Tax Receivable Agreement filed at 85% with six Blackstone-controlled TRA Party LLCs (split into Reorganization TRA Parties and Exchange TRA Parties) covering Pre-IPO Covered Tax Assets (Blocker NOLs, disallowed interest carryforwards, tax credits) and Exchange Covered Tax Assets (Section 754 basis step-ups plus imputed interest)

#### Chesapeake merger and terminating amendment

- 2021-08-10: TRA Amendment executed concurrent with the Chesapeake Energy Merger Agreement, providing that the TRA terminates in its entirety upon merger close with no Early Termination Payment owed (8-K)
- 2021-11-01: Chesapeake / Vine merger closes; TRA terminated in full with $0 substituted for the formula payment (8-K Item 1.02 / Item 2.01); Form 15-12B deregistration follows November 12, 2021

## Explanation

Vine Energy Inc. executed an 85% Up-C Tax Receivable Agreement at its March 17, 2021 IPO close with six Blackstone-controlled TRA Party LLCs (a Brix / Harvest / Vine party group, split into Reorganization TRA Parties for the former Blocker owners and Exchange TRA Parties for direct LLC Unit holders). The contract covered both Pre-IPO Covered Tax Assets (Blocker NOLs, disallowed interest expense carryforwards, and tax credit carryforwards) and Exchange Covered Tax Assets (Section 754 basis step-ups from future exchanges plus imputed interest). On August 10, 2021 Vine executed a terminating TRA Amendment concurrent with the Chesapeake Energy Merger Agreement, providing that the TRA terminates in its entirety upon merger close with no Early Termination Payment payable (substituting $0 for the formula payment, which the DEFM14A estimated at approximately $179M discounted / $208M undiscounted). The Chesapeake merger closed November 1, 2021 and the TRA terminated that day; the Brix-related $6.985M contingent liability was released into income at close, and Vine deregistered November 12, 2021. See `contract_log.md` for the full Amendment text and the comparison to the abandoned 2017 form-of TRA.
